mapper.select: SELECT currency, SUM(income) AS total_income, SUM(expenses) AS total_expenses, SUM(income) - SUM(expenses) AS balance, SUM(income_count) AS income_count, SUM(expense_count) AS expense_count FROM ( SELECT currency, SUM(amount) AS income, 0::numeric AS expenses, COUNT(*) AS income_count, 0::bigint AS expense_count FROM incomes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND income_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY currency UNION ALL SELECT currency, 0::numeric AS income, SUM(amount) AS expenses, 0::bigint AS income_count, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expenses WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expense_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY currency ) totals GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency
